description: Find directors who directed a movie that Keanu Reeves acted in, returning director name, movie title, and actor name.

expected_queries.cypher:
MATCH (actor:Person {name: $p0})-[a_rel:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[d_rel:DIRECTED]-(dir:Person)
RETURN DISTINCT dir.name AS director_name, m.title AS movie_title, actor.name AS actor_name
ORDER BY dir.name ASC, m.title ASC
expected_queries.sql_pgq:
SELECT DISTINCT
  gt.director_name,
  gt.movie_title,
  gt.actor_name
FROM GRAPH_TABLE (
  movie_graph
  MATCH (actor:Person WHERE actor.name = :p0) -[a_rel:ACTED_IN]-> (m:Movie) <-[d_rel:DIRECTED]- (dir:Person)
  COLUMNS (
    dir.name AS director_name,
    m.title AS movie_title,
    actor.name AS actor_name
  )
) AS gt
ORDER BY gt.director_name ASC, gt.movie_title ASC
expected_queries.iso_gql:
MATCH (actor:Person WHERE actor.name = $p0) -[a_rel:ACTED_IN]-> (m:Movie) <-[d_rel:DIRECTED]- (dir:Person)
RETURN DISTINCT dir.name AS director_name, m.title AS movie_title, actor.name AS actor_name
ORDER BY dir.name ASC, m.title ASC
